what_this_is: Durable study progress, kept deliberately OUTSIDE every generated artefact. The roadmap workbook is rendered from generated evidence PLUS this file, so regenerating the roadmap after new questions, new papers or historical QI arrive can never silently reset progress. No tool writes this file; tools only read it. A topic absent from `topics` below is treated as NOT_STARTED rather than being an error, so a new topic can appear without this file having to be edited first.
